_meta.purpose: NEXT_PROMPT.md sec 10: pre-registered gates, family-policy comparison, and calibration-monitor thresholds for the risk engine productionisation project. Committed before Phase 2's family-policy comparison runs and before the monitor touches real data (sec 6.3, sec 12: thresholds tuned after seeing alerts is the failure mode this file exists to prevent).
_meta.n_trials_note: The only search in this project is Phase 2's three pre-specified family policies (P1/P2/P3). Everything else is a reproduction or calibration check, not a search.

PR.claim: Port reproduction: promoted src/risk/ reproduces 008 Phase 7 exactly
PR.threshold: every compared field matches phase_7_results.json at rtol=1e-12; gate_RE.fires == true, pass count 15/16

PH.claim: Holdout reproduction: stored Phase 8 numbers match their own recorded claims (no holdout recomputation)
PH.threshold: RE_holdout_pass_count == 14, CE_holdout_reject_1pct_count == 11, per-product blocks match phase_8_holdout_results.json

DC.claim: Data contract bites: assert_risk_inputs rejects each of the four 008 Phase 0 bugs on a synthetic frame containing it
DC.threshold: 4/4 rejected with the correct named error; 0 false rejections on the clean 16-product frame

FS.claim: Family selection is justified or simplified: the winning policy of P1/P2/P3 is shipped
FS.threshold: pre-committed: ship whichever policy has the highest Gate RE pass count; tie -> ship the simplest (P2)

MB.claim: Monitor rediscovers known failures: flags PA (clustering) in development and RB/SI on holdout, with no false positives among products that passed
MB.threshold: exact product-set match in both periods

DT.claim: Determinism: portfolio_risk and every Monte Carlo path are seed-reproducible
DT.threshold: two runs, same seed, bit-identical output

NL.claim: No lookahead: regime.evaluation.no_lookahead_check passes over the ewma_vol -> var_conditional path

IR.claim: Ingestion is idempotent: refresh twice with unchanged vendor data produces byte-identical output
IR.threshold: exact byte equality on every product output

CI.claim: ruff, ruff format, mypy, pytest all clean

policies.P1: the shipped per-product map (10 ged, 3 hansen_skewt, 2 nig, 1 johnsonsu) -- phase_7_results.json family_map
policies.P3: ged everywhere except products with a BH-significant Phase 3 winner (GC, SI, per 008 Gate CD), which keep their own family

family_policy_comparison.measurement: refit the Phase 7 walk-forward OOS coverage battery (oos_coverage_test) under each policy, once, and report Gate RE's 1%-coverage pass count under each
family_policy_comparison.shipping_rule: ship whichever policy has the highest Gate RE pass count; a tie is broken in favour of the simplest policy (P2)

calibration_monitor.multiplicity_correction: Benjamini-Hochberg across the 16 products within each monitoring run, applied separately per test per level -- matching 008's own procedure (Gate CD, Gate CE)

persistence_rule.rationale: 16 products x 2 levels x 4 tests run repeatedly will produce false alarms at any fixed alpha; a single breaching window is not paged, only k=2 consecutive ones. This is a pre-registered choice, not tuned against sec 6.4's rediscovery test.

violation_rate_thresholds.note: applied at the 1% level; e.g. breach if the observed 1% VaR violation rate exceeds 2%

max_cluster_length_thresholds.note: 008's stale-bar-adjacent worst case was a Christoffersen-detected clustering failure (PA, development), not a specific cluster-length number -- these thresholds are new and pre-registered here, not derived from PA's own cluster length, to avoid gate MB's rediscovery test being tuned against its own answer

failure_mode_rules.clustering: kupiec does not breach, independence breaches
failure_mode_rules.shape: coverage and independence do not breach, but acerbi_szekely breaches (Z significantly positive)
failure_mode_rules.both: kupiec and independence both breach -- escalate

calibration_monitor.status_rule: ok if nothing breaches for < k consecutive windows; warn if a single window breaches or a metric crosses its warn threshold; breach if k consecutive windows breach the same test
